Extract the long-form region name column of an atlas

Source: R/atlas_utils.R
atlas_names.Rd

The names column of core holds the long-form display name of each region, as against the short, hemisphere-free key in region and the atlas identifier in label. For the atlases bundled here it is also the region value shipped before the 0.1.0 re-keying, which is what makes that re-keying recoverable; see legacy_region_map().

Usage

atlas_names(x)

Arguments

x

brain atlas

Value

The names column of core, unchanged: one element per core row, in core row order, with repeats and NAs retained. It is therefore row-aligned with atlas_regions() and atlas_labels(). Use unique() for the distinct set. A zero-length character vector when the atlas carries no names column.

See also

atlas_regions(), atlas_labels(), legacy_region_map()

Other atlas accessors: atlas_centerlines(), atlas_geom(), atlas_geometry_type(), atlas_labels(), atlas_meshes(), atlas_palette(), atlas_polygons(), atlas_regions(), atlas_sf(), atlas_type(), atlas_vertices(), atlas_views(), legacy_region_map()
